waivers.reason: The board is stale and this release does not refresh it. This is the second commit of the round-6 retrospective branch, which is still changing the checkers, the driver and the scaffold every conformance task runs through; scoring agents against them mid-branch would measure a moving ruler. The refresh owed is one round driven after the branch lands, and this release does not touch a rule surface an agent reads — it repairs three ways the document's own apparatus was graded as its claims.
